channel.title: World
channel.description: The Washington Post World section provides information and analysis of breaking world news stories. In addition to our world news and video, Post World News offers discussions and blogs on major international news and economic issues.

item.title: Trump says ceasefire in Lebanon is working. For residents, it’s a ‘prison.’
item.dc:creator: Mohamad El Chamaa
item.description: Israeli forces continue to occupy buffer zone in effort to dismantle Hezbollah’s infrastructure, with restrictions drawing parallels to those in the West Bank.

item.title: Rescuers search collapsed hospitals for patients trapped by Colombia quake
item.dc:creator: Christina Noriega, Joshua Yang, Victoria Craw
item.description: Dogs and drones were deployed to search for survivors. At least 220 people were reported dead in the nation’s strongest earthquake in a decade.

item.title: Pentagon report reveals steep civilian toll of Trump’s Yemen campaign
item.dc:creator: Alex Horton, Meg Kelly
item.description: The military operation was the first following Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s dismantling of an office focused on mitigating unintended casualties.

item.title: Severe malnutrition in Somalia is surging after U.S. cuts, aid groups say
item.dc:creator: Rael Ombuor
item.description: “What we are seeing is shocking and far beyond the threshold of an extremely critical emergency,” one humanitarian official said.

item.title: 30,000 pounds of beef from Argentina recalled in two states
item.dc:creator: Stella Canino-Quiñones
item.description: A recall of beef products from Corte Argentino USA affects retailers and grocery distributors in Texas and Florida.

item.title: Russia releases ailing former Marine imprisoned since 2022
item.dc:creator: Catherine Belton, Matthew Brown
item.description: Robert Gilman and his mother were on a plane back to Washington on Tuesday.

item.title: Lebanon takes step to become first Arab country to abolish death penalty
item.dc:creator: Mohamad El Chamaa
item.description: The bill would make life sentence with hard labor the highest penalty that can be imposed.

item.title: Former Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad is sentenced to death in absentia
item.dc:creator: Mohamad El Chamaa
item.description: Assad, who has been living in exile in Russia since his 2024 ouster, was sentenced for crimes against humanity and war crimes during the country's years-long civil war.

item.title: Ebola deaths surpass 2,000 in Democratic Republic of Congo
item.dc:creator: Rael Ombuor
item.description: Health experts are racing to stem the outbreak which WHO officials believe started months earlier than officially declared.

item.title: Trump-Netanyahu rift widens as election pressures pull them in opposite directions
item.dc:creator: Cat Zakrzewski, Lior Soroka, Karen DeYoung
item.description: While the Israeli leader touts a willingness to defy the U.S. on Gaza, the president needs to show progress in the foreign entanglements weighing on his approval rating.

item.title: Russia’s Supreme Court bars last anti-war party from elections
item.dc:creator: Catherine Belton, Natalia Abbakumova
item.description: Recent polls showed the liberal-leaning Yabloko could have won seats in the parliamentary elections next month.

item.title: At least 111 dead as 7.4-magnitude earthquake strikes Colombia
item.dc:creator: Nicole Bravo, Samantha Schmidt, Helena Carpio, Joshua Yang
item.description: The temblor, which struck Colombia’s Pacific coast shortly after 7:30 a.m., was also felt in Ecuador, Panama and Venezuela.

item.title: Wildfire smoke is once again pouring across the United States
item.dc:creator: Ben Noll
item.description: A weekend of new blazes across Canada’s British Columbia has created new smoke that is now wafting into the United States.

item.title: Chaos at Spain’s border underscores how migrant flows can be weaponized
item.dc:creator: Anthony Faiola, Ellen Francis, Dalila Olmo López, Beatriz Ríos
item.description: Authorities have not said who organized a suspicious border breach in Ceuta, a Spanish exclave in North Africa. Social media posts in Morocco are urging another push.
